native.bridge: All six original endpoints; no L1 fallback. Serialized ordinary-RAM adapters, exact original polling service locations, DOS vector and TIMER peers remain services.

purpose: Reset the existing common music/sample owner, probe and initialize AdLib playback, shut it down, and preserve the original CPU-loop calibration/IRQ measurement protocol without implementing DOS interrupt delivery or TIMER.

inputs: Reset: borrowed AudioState and transient AudioResetCells expansion of the same owner. No independent persistent PCM object.
Lifetime: fresh borrowed attempted byte and timer handle; success-only resumption of a fresh work record; raw status bytes and opaque TIMER results.
Calibration: external progress bias, live marker/counter/progress after each delivered service; one-million-visit L1 diagnostic budget.
Handlers: actual interrupted CX/DX measurements, DOS vector service outputs/status.
outputs: Reset clears exactly the 1160 bytes common owner; outside fields including operator indices, handles, attempted, calibration and resident PCM buffers survive.

Init AX=1 on successful or cached attempt,0 on probe failure; attempted remains set even on failure. Shutdown conditionally removes the possibly stale handle, unconditionally restores TIMER, clears attempted and silences.
Calibration stores raw interrupted CX and DX words. Only multiplier low byte is consumed by accepted I/O delay. It performs no divide, speed conversion, saturation, rounding or zero-divisor test.

Per-poll native arithmetic decrements the 16-bit remainder, increments wrapping progress once per exhausted 65536-iteration block, and examines high marker byte while waiting for Begin, low byte only at a completed block.
effects: Ordered OPL writes/status reads, PIC EOI, DOS INT08 vector get/set/restore, explicit calibration IRQ waits and TIMER install/register/remove/restore requests.

Begin acknowledges PIC before installing Finish and returns live marker0100. Finish acknowledges PIC before restoring previous vector, then stores CX and interrupted DX, sets CX=1 and AL=1 while retaining AH from DOS. IRET flags restoration is delivery service responsibility.

Bridge preserves all L1 normal/error prefix registers, stack protocol and flags. Clear forces DF=0; other entries preserve incoming DF through their peers. No physical CPU-time spin is performed by ordinary native code.
preconditions: Serialized ordinary RAM. Caller frame and live code disjoint from reset/state; service inputs bound to the original ABI. No instruction-level observation between a typed reset and its publication.
Resume lifetime work only after requested service success; stop at DONE. Error statuses return without invented restoration or later steps.

Native port must supply measurement progress/remainder or implement the virtual polling/interrupt service with original word units and progress bias. DOS elapsed time is not provided by portable code.

assumptions: Native CPU speed is not DOS timing. The host supplies virtual delivery/measurement values and platform owns real I/O timing; DelaySoundIo uses the separately accepted exact finite product contract, including zero product65536.
Symbolic startup/shutdown composition contracts the separately accepted silence child and calibration service. Full real peers and full ordered port lists are compiled/L0/scenario evidence.

Symbolic composed calibration delivers Begin and Finish within two visits per polling phase, with all word values and explicit service failures admitted. Arbitrary counter/marker/budget transitions have separate actual polling-body-cut profiles.
No Amiga equivalence, hardware detection on real OPL cards or instruction-cycle accuracy is claimed.
